tok 1.0 "Order fulfillment"

pool shop "E-commerce company"
  lane system "System"
    start placed "Order placed"
    task record "Record the order details"
    task pay "Process the payment"
    xor payok "Payment successful?"
    task notifyfail "Notify the customer"
    end failed "Order failed"
    task check "Check stock availability"
    xor instock "Items in stock?"
    task backorder "Initiate a back-order"
    task delay "Inform the customer about the delay"
    task receiveback "Receive the back-order"
    xor stockmerge
    and split
    and join
    task dispatch "Dispatch the order"
    task confirm "Send a shipping confirmation"
    task update "Update the inventory levels"
    task delivered "Confirm the delivery"
    task feedback "Send a follow-up email for feedback"
    xor issues "Issues reported?"
    task label "Send a return shipping label"
    task receive "Receive the returned items"
    task inspect "Inspect the returned items"
    task refund "Process a refund or replacement"
    end done "Order completed"
    end returned "Return handled"
  lane warehouse "Warehouse"
    task pick "Pick the items from the warehouse"
    task qc "Perform quality control on the picked items"
    xor gift "Gift wrapping requested?"
    task wrap "Wrap the gift"
    xor giftmerge
    task pack "Package the items"
  lane shipping "Shipping department"
    task docs "Prepare shipping documents"
    xor intl "International order?"
    task customs "Prepare customs documentation"
    xor intlmerge
    task labels "Prepare shipping labels"

flow placed -> record -> pay -> payok
flow payok -> notifyfail "no"
flow notifyfail -> failed
flow payok -> check "yes"
flow check -> instock
flow instock -> backorder "no"
flow backorder -> delay -> receiveback -> stockmerge
flow instock -> stockmerge "yes"
flow stockmerge -> pick -> qc -> split
flow split -> gift
flow gift -> wrap "yes"
flow gift -> giftmerge "no"
flow wrap -> giftmerge
flow giftmerge -> pack -> join
flow split -> docs -> intl
flow intl -> customs "yes"
flow intl -> intlmerge "no"
flow customs -> intlmerge
flow intlmerge -> labels -> join
flow join -> dispatch -> confirm -> update -> delivered -> feedback -> issues
flow issues -> label "yes"
flow label -> receive -> inspect -> refund -> returned
flow issues -> done "no"
